notes.title: [Ripple Island] Command Description
notes.content:
Hi SUNSOFT Family!

Sorry about the  (NES era) game's manual being only in Japanese!

This is gallery art and there are no plans to update the English version.

However, there are many retro games that are only written in the manual.

Especially “Ripple Island” cannot be played if you don't know how to use the commands.

So we have created an explanation of the commands of “Ripple Island” in English!



Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902441/5e5ed770204ccb4e669dc077357ff2472729be65.jpg[/img]

notes.title: English Update!
notes.content:
Three Games are now available in English!
If the language setting in the options is set to English, the game will automatically switch to English as well. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: English Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Apologies for the long silence and thank you for your patience! 

Today, we're excited to announce an update to the Retro Game Selection! 
All three titles will now be available in English. 
You can finally play Ripple Island in English! The update is scheduled to go live around 4 PM Japan time.

 Stay tuned and enjoy!
